why: Issue #597. `readDetectedPads` lists every pad without its verdict, so a pad the reader refuses reaches the assignment panel looking readable. The HUD suites write their pads by hand and cannot see this; the producer case is the only thing that can. Killed by the case that lists an unmapped pad with its reason.
killedBy: readDetectedPads: the controller assignment panel's live list lists a pad Tanks will not read WITH its reason, and leaves a readable pad unmarked (issue #597)
